# 一个部分的四种情形：以包含比较有它与无它的水平路径，部分扩大、缩小、保持不变或混合；每步给回不少于所取者不关闭，给予不多于所取者不打开；混合的部分不为包含定序，给它定序需要度量 / Four cases of a part: comparing the level paths with and without it by inclusion, a part widens, narrows, keeps the same or is mixed; giving back at least what it takes at every step closes nothing, giving no more than it takes opens nothing; a mixed part is not ordered by inclusion, and ordering it needs a measure

## 主张 Claim

一条水平路径 l 包含另一条 l′（Web.Includes），是指每一步 l 接纳 l′ 所接纳的每个形成；包含是预序（Web.Includes.refl、Web.Includes.trans）。l 超出 l′（Web.Exceeds），是指在某步 l 接纳一个 l′ 不接纳的形成；包含 l′ 的路径不被 l′ 超出（Web.Includes.not_exceeded）。在平衡的流中，扣留一个部分后的水平存在时：部分每步给每个条件的不少于从它取走的，则有它的水平包含无它的，它不关闭任何东西（Flow.Balances.closes_nothing）；每步给予不多于取走的，则无它的水平包含有它的，它不打开任何东西（Flow.Balances.opens_nothing）；恰好给回所取的，不改变能形成什么（Flow.Balances.changes_nothing）。以两个方向的包含比较有它与无它，部分扩大、缩小、保持不变或混合（这一划分是经典逻辑，不是这里的定理）；每种情形的见证都给出扣留后的水平。扩大，有它的包含并超出无它的：Inflow 中扣留给予者的部分（Restoring.Inflow.giverPart）后条件停在零（Restoring.Inflow.withheld），false 在任何一步都不被接纳，有它时 false 从第一步起被支持（Restoring.Inflow.widens）。缩小，反过来：Clearing 中扣留清除者的部分后资源每步升一、栖息地停在二（Clearing.withheld），栖居者每步都被接纳（Clearing.admitted_without），有它时从第二步起不被支持（Clearing.unsupported_with），所以它不打开任何东西并关闭栖居者（Clearing.narrows）。保持不变，即 changes_nothing 的情形。混合，二者各超出对方：Transfer 中传送者在第零步从第一个条件取一单位给第二个，扣留后第一个条件停在一、第二个停在零（Transfer.withheld）；有它时从第一步起第二个形成被支持而第一个不被支持，无它时每步第一个被接纳而第二个不被接纳（Transfer.mixed）。混合的部分不为包含定序：给它定序需要权衡一些可能性与另一些的度量，那是另一个前提。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A level path l includes another l′ (Web.Includes) when at every step l admits every formation l′ admits; inclusion is a preorder (Web.Includes.refl, Web.Includes.trans). l exceeds l′ (Web.Exceeds) when at some step l admits a formation l′ does not; a path that includes l′ is not exceeded by it (Web.Includes.not_exceeded). In a balanced flow, where the levels without a part exist: a part giving each condition at every step at least what it takes from it closes nothing, the levels with it including those without it (Flow.Balances.closes_nothing); one giving no more than it takes opens nothing, the levels without it including those with it (Flow.Balances.opens_nothing); one giving back exactly what it takes changes nothing that can form (Flow.Balances.changes_nothing). Compared by inclusion in both directions with the levels without it, a part widens, narrows, keeps the same or is mixed (this split is classical logic, not a theorem here); the witness of each case exhibits its levels without the part. It widens, the levels with it including and exceeding those without it: in Inflow, without the giver's part (Restoring.Inflow.giverPart) the condition stays at zero (Restoring.Inflow.withheld) and false is admitted at no step, while with it false is supported from step one on (Restoring.Inflow.widens). It narrows, the converse: in Clearing, without the clearer's part the resource rises by one at each step and the habitat stays at two (Clearing.withheld), and the dweller is admitted at every step (Clearing.admitted_without), while with the part it is not supported from step two on (Clearing.unsupported_with); so the part opens nothing and closes the dweller (Clearing.narrows). It keeps the same, the case of changes_nothing. It is mixed, each path exceeding the other: in Transfer the conveyor takes a unit from the first condition at step zero and gives it to the second; without its part the first condition stays at one and the second at zero (Transfer.withheld); with it, from step one on, the second formation is supported and the first is not, while without it the first is admitted at every step and the second at none (Transfer.mixed). A mixed part is not ordered by inclusion: ordering it needs a measure trading some possibilities against others, which is a further premise. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Admission.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Admission.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 有部分的流平衡；扣留后的水平从同一起点按扣留后的流平衡（每个见证中存在且唯一）。 / The flow with the part balances; the levels without the part balance the withheld flow from the same start (in each witness they exist and are unique).
- closes_nothing、opens_nothing 与 changes_nothing 比较部分在每步、每个条件上的取用与给予。 / closes_nothing, opens_nothing and changes_nothing compare the part's taking and giving at every step and on every condition.
- 包含比较每步被接纳的形成；分为四种情形是对两个包含的经典逻辑，不是 Lean 定理。 / Inclusion compares the formations admitted at each step; the split into four cases is classical logic over the two inclusions, not a Lean theorem.
- 离散的步（从第零步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren 写道，生成的是“its existence creates more possibilities of becoming - more future, not less”，并说可以辨认三种动力学（“degenerative/neutral/generative”）。Ren 确认：一个将来保留另一个所有的并有所增加时更多；整体从不是任何中心对它的模型，以包含比较不许可强加的终结，许可它需要权衡的度量，那是另一个前提。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：扩大读作生成的，缩小读作退化的，保持不变读作中性的；混合的部分说明这三种在包含之下不穷尽，这与 Ren 确认的第二项读法一致：给混合定序需要度量。比较的是哪些形成被接纳；Ren 也提到的更新能力与关系的丰富没有比较。读法与名称是 AI 的。 / Ren wrote that being generative is that “its existence creates more possibilities of becoming - more future, not less”, and that degenerative, neutral and generative dynamics can be identified (“degenerative/neutral/generative”). Ren confirmed that one future has more than another when it keeps everything the other has and adds some, and that the whole is never any center's model of it, so comparison by inclusion licenses no imposed ending; licensing one needs a measure that trades possibilities, a further premise. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): widening reads as generative, narrowing as degenerative and keeping the same as neutral; the mixed case shows that the three are not exhaustive under inclusion, in line with Ren's second confirmed reading: ordering a mixed part needs a measure. What is compared is which formations are admitted; renewal capacity and richness of relations, which Ren also named, are not compared. The reading and the names are the AI's.

比较只看每步哪些形成被接纳，不比较多步可达、更新能力或关系的丰富；四种情形的划分是经典逻辑，不是 Lean 定理；“保持不变”没有单独的见证，由 changes_nothing 给出；其余交换不随之调整；扣留后没有平衡的水平时无可比较；混合的部分不为包含定序；见证都是最小的，其终结由活动或要求规定，见证表明它们与平衡、支持与依存相容；不含伦理谓词，不说哪个部分应当被扣留或终结；把扩大、缩小、保持不变读作生成的、退化的、中性的，是 AI 的读法，待 Ren；名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定。 / The comparison looks only at which formations are admitted at each step, not at reachability over several steps, renewal capacity or richness of relations; the split into four cases is classical logic, not a Lean theorem; keeping the same has no separate witness and is given by changes_nothing; the rest of the exchange does not adjust; where no level path balances the flow without the part there is nothing to compare; a mixed part is not ordered by inclusion; the witnesses are minimal, their endings stipulated in activity or requirements and shown consistent with balance, support and dependence; contains no ethical predicate and does not say which part should be withheld or ended; reading widening, narrowing and keeping the same as generative, degenerative and neutral is the AI's reading, pending Ren; the names are the AI's wording, for Ren to choose.
